crossRefs.note: After him, the Levites, Rehum the son of Bani made repairs. Next to him, Hashabiah, the ruler of half the district of…
The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

people.name: Hashabiah
people.line: A Levite who returned from Babylonian exile.

people.name: Jeshaiah
people.line: A Levite who accompanied Ezra to Jerusalem.

people.name: Merari
people.line: The third son of Levi and founder of the Merarites.

translations.web: and Hashabiah, and with him Jeshaiah of the sons of Merari, his brothers and their sons, twenty;
translations.bsb: also Hashabiah, together with Jeshaiah, from the descendants of Merari, and his brothers and their sons, 20 men.
